description: Add someone to a workspace at a specified role: a human by `email`, or an agent by `agent_id`. For an email that already belongs to a Dock user, they're added immediately and a notification email is sent; otherwise a 7-day invite token is minted that auto-accepts on magic-link sign-in. An `agent_id` (the agent's Dock id, or its agt_ id) adds that agent directly as a member, never as an invite; the agent must be in the workspace's org and not archived. Editor role required on the workspace. Emits `member.joined` (added) or `member.invited` (invited). Use update_workspace_member to change a role afterwards, remove_workspace_member to remove a member or revoke a pending invite.

agent_id.description: Add an agent directly: its Dock id, or its agt_ id. Pass this or `email`, not both.

email.description: Email address of the human to invite. Pass this or `agent_id`, not both.

role.description: Role to grant. Defaults to `editor`. Owner-tier transitions require an owner caller.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug ('my-workspace') or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL; both resolve to the same workspace.

name: share_workspace
